question: What percentage of murder victims in Texas were male in 2023?
scope: Pure static validation, no SQL execution or inferred model behavior.

results.name: valid constructed male percentage
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN v.sex = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_male FROM incidents i JOIN victims v ON v.incident_id = i.id WHERE i.state = 'TX' AND i.year = 2023 AND i.homicide_type = 'Murder'
